notes.title: Update Notice – 2025-09-01
notes.notes:
[b]A new season begins![/b] We're bringing brand new seasonal content, making balance adjustments, optimizing some features, and fixing some bugs.

[h2]New Content[/h2]
[b]New Collection[/b]
[list]
[*]Victory Effect - City-Wide Bounty
[/list]

[b]New Hero Skins[/b]
[list]
[*]Naga Queen - Naga Valkyrie
[*]The Tyrant of Frost Shadow - General of the Frozen Wasteland
[*]Astral Mage - Astromancer
[*]Jungle Prophet - Trojan Horse
[*]Chaos Overlord - Demon Prototype
[*]Alchemist - Mad Scientist
[/list]

[b]New Heroes[/b]
[list]
[*]Dragon Overlord
[*]Bounty Hunter
[/list]

[b]New Treasures[/b]
[list]
[*]Life-Drinker Blade
[*]EXP Distributor
[*]Goblin Stardust
[/list]

[h2]Balance Adjustments[/h2]
[b]Heroes[/b]

[b]Mystic Mage[/b]
[list]
[*]Talent: After a battle begins, each time an Ultimate is cast, its damage is increased by 50%, up to a maximum of [strike]200%[/strike] -> 300%.
[/list]

[b]Venom Sorcerer[/b]
[list]
[*]Talent: All Poison damage taken by enemies is increased by (10 + Hero Level*[strike]2.5[/strike]) -> (10 + Hero Level*3).
[/list]

[b]Treasures[/b]

[b]Treasure Journal / Grimoire Journal / Store Membership / Archmage's Bracelet[/b]
[list]
[*]The above treasures now strictly correct for independent probability events. Their effects in-use will now be perfectly consistent with the stated probabilities.
[/list]

[b]Goblin Part[/b]
[list]
[*]The price of [Random Skill] in the Skill Store is reduced by [strike]10/15/15[/strike] -> 15/15/15 Gold, capped at 1200/1400/1600 Gold.
[*]You can hold up to 3 at the same time.
[/list]

[b]Moonlit Ring[/b]
[list]
[*]When a rare skill appears in the store, gain 20 Gold, up to a maximum of 1000/1200/1400 Gold.
[*]The refresh pool restriction has been removed. You can hold up to 3 at the same time.
[/list]

[b]Mythic Relic[/b]
[list]
[*]On use, choose a mythic skill to obtain, but lose [strike]300/250/200[/strike] -> 250/200/150 Gold per round for 4 rounds.
[/list]

[b]Sacred Feather[/b]
[list]
[*]Increases damage taken on battle defeat by 1. On activation, sets your Health to match the highest in the match (will not exceed your Max Health).
[/list]

[b]Vampire Grail - Phase 2[/b]
[list]
[*]Choose a branch. At the start of the round, sacrifice [strike]2[/strike] -> 1-2 Player Life to gain 1 skill from the chosen branch.
[/list]

[b]Battle Supply Chest - Phase 3[/b]
[list]
[*]Each time a hero is upgraded, recover 2 Player Life. When this treasure is obtained, lose [strike]3[/strike] -> 4 Player Life.
[/list]

[b]Healing Gem - Phase 3[/b]
[list]
[*]When the Skill Store is refreshed [strike]4[/strike] -> 5 times within a round, recover 2 Life.
[/list]

[b]Skills[/b]

[b]Counterattack[/b]
[list]
[*]Each Dodge has a 60% chance to deal 20 physical damage to the enemy. This damage cannot be dodged.
[/list]

[b]Holy Explosion[/b]
[list]
[*]At the start of battle, deal Holy Damage to the enemy equal to 30% of their Max HP, and reduce their Max HP by the same amount.
[/list]

[b]Healing Array[/b]
[list]
[*]When your HP first falls below 30%, instantly heal 500 HP, then heal 90 HP every 0.3s for 6s.
[/list]

[b]Fury Dodge[/b]
[list]
[*][i]Old Effect:[/i] While in Fury state, increase Dodge by 1 every 0.5s.
[*][i]New Effect:[/i] While in Fury state, increase Dodge by 4.
[/list]

[b]Fury Crit[/b]
[list]
[*][i]Old Effect:[/i] While in Fury state, increase Crit by 1 every 0.5s.
[*][i]New Effect:[/i] While in Fury state, increase Crit by 4.
[/list]

[h2]Feature Optimizations and Additions[/h2]
[list]
[*]Downloads on the Google Play Store are now available in Russia and Japan.
[*]Prevented players from facing the same opponent in consecutive rounds in the short term.
[*]Increased the skill purchase time for players in Golden rank and below, based on their highest-ever rank.
[*]Added the Crystal Chest to the store. Players can use Brawl Crystals to open them and obtain hero skins, hero avatars, and other resources.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where combat statistics were sometimes inaccurate.
[*]Fixed an issue where players would sometimes fail to properly enter a tournament battle.
[*]Fixed an issue where switching accounts could cause an anomaly in the number of Tarot bets.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notice – 2025-07-01
notes.notes:
New season has launched! In addition to regular content updates, we've implemented Treasure/Hero locking features and Treasure group restrictions, added Tournament revival limitations, adjusted balance, optimized some features, and fixed several bugs.

[h3]New Heroes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Woodland Dryad
[*] Lunar Hunter
[/list]

[h3]New Treasures:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Sacred Feather
[*] Archmage's Bracelet
[*] Pure Codex
[/list]

[h3]New Collections:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Battle Field - Luminous Moon Altar
[*] Pepper Shooter - Green Pepper Shooter
[*] Frostborne Lord - Ancient Frozen Soul
[*] Royal Knight - Imperial Guard Leader
[*] Holy Knight - Mithril Knight
[/list]

[h3]New Features:[/h3]
[b]Treasure/Hero Locking[/b]
[list]
[*] When players have unlocked more than 60 treasures and 40 heroes (excluding weekly free rotation), they can freely disable excess content in the Gallery. Disabled content will not appear in selection lists.
[/list]

[b]Treasure Group Restrictions[/b]
[list]
[*] To ensure individual treasures remain playable while preventing multiple treasures from becoming too dominant, we've grouped treasures of similar types or trigger conditions. Treasures within the same group will have a limit on how many can be held.
[*] Refresh-type treasures (Winter Bless, Treasure Journal, Store Membership, Bloodshed Membership, Moonlit Ring) are currently limited to two at a time. This restriction may later be applied to RNG-based or damage reduction/recovery treasures.
[/list]

[b]Tournament Revival Limitations[/b]
[list]
[*] In tournaments, if a player is revived through the Flowers mechanism, they will be unable to receive flowers for the next month (7 tournament cycles).
[/list]

[h3]Feature Changes and Optimizations:[/h3]

[b]Season Handbook Adjustments:[/b]
[list]
[*] The 5 Royale Chests in the Season Handbook have been converted to equivalent Royale Crystals and distributed throughout the track.
[/list]

[b]Haste Branch Skill Display Adjustments:[/b]
[list]
[*] Icons enlarged, and backgrounds will automatically adapt to content size.
[/list]

[b]Font Adjustments[/b]
[list]
[*] Optimized and aligned fonts to improve appearance across different language environments.
[/list]

[b]Animation Optimizations[/b]
[list]
[*] Optimized animations in various parts of the main game interface.
[/list]

[h3]Balance Changes:[/h3]

[b]Maximum Refresh Adjustment:[/b]
[list]
[*] Maximum number of refreshes per round (Skill Store) 30 -> 20.
[/list]

[h3]Heroes:[/h3]

[b]Furious Mage[/b]
[list]
[*] Talent skills no longer benefit from Haste bonuses
[/list]

[b]Evil Spirit Matriarch[/b]
[list]
[*] Energy recovery adjusted
[*] Talent skills no longer benefit from Haste bonuses
[/list]

[b]Pepper Shooter[/b]
[list]
[*] Fire a bullet and curse the enemy, lasting for 4 seconds. During this period, apply 35 -> 30 stacks of Wound to the enemy every 1 second.
[/list]

[b]Wolf Hunter[/b]
[list]
[*] Attack power 24 -> 26
[*] Wealth Plunder
[*] Gain 30 gold after each victorious battle, while the opponent loses 30 gold, with a (25%+Player Hero Level*2%) -> (20%+Player Hero Level*4%) chance to plunder double.
[/list]

[b]Frostborne Lord[/b]
[list]
[*] Meteor Icefall
[*] Summons ice blocks to fall from the sky, stunning the enemy for 0.8s and dealing 250 -> 280 Physical damage.
[/list]

[b]Tiger Shooter[/b]
[list]
[*] Lunar Blessing
[*] Each Ultimate cast increases ATK SPD by 30%, lasting for 2 -> 3 seconds.
[/list]

[b]Panda Warrior[/b]
[list]
[*] Booze Guard
[*] Each time the hero takes damage, there is a 33% -> 40% chance to recover (Hero Level+5) HP.
[/list]

[h3]Treasures:[/h3]

[b]Piggy Bank[/b]
[list]
[*] Each round, 100 -> 50 Gold is automatically deposited into the piggy bank. The total amount inside earns 15%/20%/30% -> 20%/30%/50% interest per round. You can choose to active and break the piggy bank at any time to collect all the gold inside at once.

[b]Battlefield Cleaner Stage 1[/b]

notes.title: Solution for Game Update Getting Stuck
notes.notes:
Some players have been experiencing issues with updates getting stuck at a certain progress point after May 12th. After communicating and investigating with Steam support, we have reached a conclusion on this issue.

The problem is caused by Steam's recent implementation of a new compression format, which is incompatible with older versions of the Steam client. As a result, players who aren't using the latest version of the Steam client may experience incomplete game updates.

If you're experiencing this issue, please update to the latest version of the Steam client or uninstall and reinstall the Steam client. Feel free to contact us if you encounter any other problems.
